```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#18324B"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#526777"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#18324B"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E4EBF0"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")
groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1L, 0L),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(substr(resolved_at, 1, 10)) - date),
    time_bucket = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    time_bucket = factor(
      time_bucket,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(accuracy)

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_absolute_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "#167D8D", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(color = "#167D8D", fill = "#F2B84B", shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "More than 90 days" = ">90 days",
    "30 to 90 days" = "30-90 days",
    "7 to 30 days" = "7-30 days",
    "1 to 7 days" = "1-7 days",
    "Final day" = "Final day"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time to resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
final_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

ggplot(final_day, aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.05,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "#167D8D",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts cluster near certainty",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- final_day |>
  mutate(probability_bin = cut(
    probability,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#8B9AA7") +
  geom_line(color = "#167D8D", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n),
    color = "white",
    fill = "#E07A5F",
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day calibration varies by probability",
    subtitle = "Actual YES rates versus predicted probabilities, in 10-point bins",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES rate",
    size = "Markets in bin"
  )
```
